objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Find a SQL injection in the Hackazon store and use it to read the flag stored in the flags table of the ctf database, next to the store's own.
hints: Upstream's VULNERABILITIES.md explains how the injected fields are configured per page: the product page and the search by category are two of them.
Some injections show no error at all. The answer then comes from how the page changes, one yes/no question at a time.

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which URL parameter of the product page selects the product, and reaches the query unescaped?

steps.title: Name the variant
steps.prompt: The category search filters products without showing any database error. What is that SQL injection variant called?

steps.title: Enumerate the databases
steps.prompt: Which built-in schema lists the databases and tables the store's database user can read, including the ctf one?
